fields.Name: User Routine Dispatcher
fields.Description: Every-minute sweep that claims and executes due user routines (MJ: User Routines) — the single dispatcher behind the User Routines feature. Claims each due routine by advancing NextRunAt BEFORE running so a crash mid-run does not re-run it; ConcurrencyMode=Skip keeps two dispatcher sweeps from running at once across servers, which is what stops a routine running twice. Routine-level failures are isolated and recorded on their MJ: User Routine Runs rows — the sweep itself only fails on infrastructure errors.
